description: Defines the SimpleObserverableGrain class implementing an Orleans grain with observer pattern functionality, state management, and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: SimpleObserverableGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that manages internal state variables, observes external grain observers, and performs asynchronous event handling.

methods.name: SimpleObserverableGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes logger and observer manager.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Prepares grain upon activation, logs activation event.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets value of A and asynchronously raises state update event after a delay.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets value of B and asynchronously raises state update event after a delay.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B, with optional parameters.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds an observer to the observer manager.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer from the observer manager.

methods.name: RaiseStateUpdateEvent
methods.description: Notifies all observers of the current state changes.
